result.stdout:
wikidown — maintain a Wikidown /docs wiki

Usage:
  wikidown <command> [--root <path>] [options]

Commands:
  list     [--path /Link/Path]                 list children of a page (or root)
  read     --path /Link/Path                   print page markdown to stdout
  write    --path /Link/Path [--file F | --stdin]  write/overwrite a page
  new      --path /Link/Path [--title T] [--file F | --stdin]  create a page
  move     --from /A --to /B [--dry-run]       rename/move a page (and subpages);
           rewrites inbound links and the moved page's own relative links
  delete   --path /P [--recursive]             delete a page (and optionally subpages)
  reorder  --folder /P --names a,b,c           rewrite .order for a folder
  search   --query <text> [--case-sensitive]   search all page bodies
  check-links  [--no-absolute-check] [--no-index-check]  validate relative
               links/images; also flags absolute title-path body links and
               folders with a missing or under-linking index page, unless disabled
  backfill-breadcrumbs [--dry-run]             add/refresh the breadcrumb line
               on every existing page that predates it (write/move do this
               automatically going forward; this is a one-time catch-up)
  export-pdf --output <path> [--title T] [--from /Link/Path]
               [--no-toc] [--no-cover] [--allow-html-skip]
               combine the wiki (or a subtree) into one linked PDF
  init     [--agents claude|copilot|all|none] [--force]
           seed the wiki and install AI agent configs (Claude Code +
           GitHub Copilot) in the folder containing the wiki root

Global:
  --root <path>   path to docs folder (default: ./docs)
